steps.summary: Implement and authority-bind the bounded canonical B1 adapter, then rerun the real-loader and CPU-forward gates.
Build immutable local launch descriptors and complete CPU gate six.
Verify authorized remote binding and real-loader preflight, restoring the same Studio to CPU only when required by observed control-plane state.
Execute the registered twelve-trial S1 campaign and evaluate each trial under the explicitly owner-authorized same-Studio lifecycle.
Release paid GPU, apply retention, publish final authority, and close S1.
